source_summary: Horizontal ink-and-light-wash Chinese landscape with a large old willow, misty distant hills, two traveling figures, flowering foreground shrubs, rocky riverbank shallows, a small right-shore structure, and small birds in open sky. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: left_misty_mountain_ridge
motifs.description: Soft distant mountain ridge at the upper left, including the layered rounded peaks and hazy ink washes partly seen behind the willow.
must_preserve: pale graded wash forming receding peaks
soft blurred ridge edges
small darker crest accents and clustered tree-like dots
misty overlap where mountains disappear behind foreground willow

motifs.name: ancient_willow_tree
motifs.description: The full visible old willow: gnarled trunk and roots at the left edge, heavy leaning limbs, sweeping arched boughs across the upper composition, and long pendant willow twigs.
must_preserve: thick-to-thin calligraphic contour lines of trunk and limbs
dark knotted bark spots and root texture
long fine hanging willow strands
small black buds and leaf dots along branches
irregular tapering of the sweeping upper boughs

motifs.name: central_robed_scholar
motifs.description: Standing robed scholar near the lower center, facing left under the willow with head covering, long sleeves, sash, and visible feet.
must_preserve: delicate angular robe-outline linework
fold lines down the sleeves and hem
small head and cap geometry
dark belt/sash accent
subtle pale wash inside the robe
walking stance and exposed shoes

motifs.name: lower_left_attendant
motifs.description: Small bent attendant at the lower left, carrying a bundled load or implements while walking beneath the willow.
must_preserve: stooped posture and compact silhouette
thin contour lines of tunic, legs, and head covering
diagonal carried bundle or pole strokes
small dark accents at hair, hands, and feet
light wash defining clothing volume

motifs.name: foreground_flowering_shrub_belt
motifs.description: Low flowering shrub and brush belt across the lower foreground around the figures, including dotted blossoms, thin twig networks, and small clustered leaves.
must_preserve: fine branching twig linework
dense black blossom and leaf dots
irregular spacing of shrub clusters
overlapping stems around rocks and feet
small warm-brown wash accents at the base

motifs.name: rocky_bank_and_shallows
motifs.description: Foreground rocky riverbank and shallow water forms through the lower middle and right, including angular rocks, eroded ledges, dotted stones, and horizontal water-wash marks.
must_preserve: angular outlined rock planes
dark pebble dots along the bank
dry-brush striations on eroded slopes
pale horizontal water strokes
soft wash transitions between earth bank and shallow water
broken ink texture on rock edges

motifs.name: right_shore_hut_and_rocks
motifs.description: Small right-bank shore motif with low hut or roof form, adjacent rocks, and nearby flowering shrub clusters at the far right lower edge.
must_preserve: simple sloping roof geometry
dark roof-edge and corner dots
small surrounding rock silhouettes
thin shoreline strokes
dotted blossom clusters above and beside the structure
light wash under the bank

motifs.name: small_birds_in_sky
motifs.description: Sparse birds in the open upper sky, including the larger fluttering bird at upper right of center and the smaller bird strokes nearby.
must_preserve: minimal V-shaped wing strokes
small dark head and tail marks
dry-brush feather flicks
varied scale between birds
ample surrounding empty space for sky placement

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
